project_title: Navigating Market Shifts: Predictive Insights into Success and Failure Factors Across Industries
objective: Determine why companies succeed or fail using predictive analytics on a cross-industry dataset, identify early warning signals, and deliver actionable strategic insights.

compartmentalization.company_data: Analyzed both at individual (case studies) and aggregated (industry mean) levels
compartmentalization.world_data: Contextual layer aligned in time series
compartmentalization.time_dimension: Synchronize all datasets quarterly to assess lagged effects

analysis_strategy.individual_vs_aggregated: Use hierarchical multilevel models (Level 1: individual companies; Level 2: industry aggregates)
analysis_strategy.hierarchical_modeling: Capture unique company behaviors and general cross-industry trends

artifact_options.description: Streamlit app with composite success gauge, SHAP explanations, and world-fiscal timeline overlay

artifact_options.name: marketshift_predictor
artifact_options.description: pip-installable code for data prep and .fit()/ .predict() API
Publish cleaned, time-aligned multi-modal panel on Zenodo with data descriptor

success_metrics.ROA_KPI: 1 if average ROA > industry median over window, else 0
success_metrics.market_share_KPI: 1 if market share increases then holds ±1ppt for 2 years, else 0
success_metrics.composite_score: C = (S + R + M) / 3 (equal weights) or PCA-derived weights

modeling_strategy.target: Binary classification or regression on composite_score
modeling_strategy.optional: Late-fusion ensemble of numeric and text models; survival analysis

pipeline_structure: data_ingestion.py: pull raw data (financial, macro, ESG, text, patents)
feature_engineering.py: compute rev_growth, de_ratio, sentiment scores, embeddings, lagged macro
modeling.py: fit baseline and advanced models, compute SHAP values

timeline.days_1: Finalize artifact choice, setup repo & environment

current_state.EDGAR_parsed: Separate CSVs & Parquets per ticker from 2009 onward
current_state.artifacts_per_company: 12–20+ rows depending on quarterly vs annual metrics
current_state.missing_metrics: Some CSVs lack total_revenue but may have net_income

immediate_next_steps: Validate all parsed CSVs for required columns (total_revenue, net_income, date)
Consolidate per-ticker CSVs into a single firm–quarter panel
Filter panel rows by listing and delisting dates
Merge macro FRED series on quarter_end_date
Impute or drop missing values according to data quality
Compute S, R, M and composite_score for each firm
Run quick baseline logistic regression to verify panel integrity
